purpose: P007 native MotionScript generation experiment — tiny frozen prompts; not training data.

tasks.prompt: Write a MotionScript 0.2 scene (320x180, 3s) with a cyan rectangle that falls down, seal at 1s after the first animation, then fade opacity after the seal, seal at 2s, and complete. Progressive seals required.

Write a MotionScript 0.2 scene (200x200, 2s) with a white circle (use id badge, not the word circle as the id) centered and a text label (id label) below it saying OK. No animation tracks. Offline-complete is enough; seals optional. Do not use markdown fences.

Write a MotionScript 0.2 scene that draws a path named rail using move/line commands and stroke #rrggbb width N, then operators rail { trim 0, 0, 0; }, then animate rail.trim.end from 0 to 1 over 1500ms. Include requires "geometry.trimPath". Seal once useful, then complete. Do not invent points[] or strokeWidth or trimPath fields. Do not use markdown fences.
